card.name: Inside capitalized EMBRYO in warnings
card.fires_on: The letter O at the end of the split capitalized word EMBRY-O, mostly in boxed warning titles such as EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY. Also the V in capitalized AGGRAVATE.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL warning
modes.description: The final O piece of EMBRYO in an all-caps boxed warning heading, just before the hyphen and FETAL.
modes.example: WARNING: DIARRHEA AND EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY Z

modes.label: Other capitalized words
modes.description: A middle piece of other all-caps words, such as EMBRYOLOGY in a list of fields or AGGRAVATE.
modes.example: , including the fields of ALLERGOLOGY, ANATOMY, BACTERIOLOGY, BOTANY, DENTISTRY, EMBRY<<O>>LOGY, ENVIRONMENTALISM, ET

card.plain: It fires inside the capitalized word EMBRYO when it is spelled out in a boxed warning title.
